**In one line**: Mark Zuckerberg reportedly said the tech industry is not united on AI regulation, singling out OpenAI and Anthropic.

### Key points
- Zuckerberg is reported to have argued that companies do not share a single stance on how AI should be regulated.
- He reportedly named leading AI developers OpenAI and Anthropic directly in the remarks.
- The comments renew attention on how differently big tech firms approach the scope and strictness of AI rules.

### Why it matters
Regulation shapes how fast each company can ship and how it frames safety policy. A visible split between Meta, OpenAI, and Anthropic suggests the industry may struggle to present a unified voice in upcoming US and global policy debates. (The full text of the remarks could not be independently confirmed.)
